description: This data set is an open map of health facilities in Nigeria, giving the location of primary health centres, hospitals and other facilities across the country. It is produced by the GRID3 programme, with the v2.0 and v3.0 editions compiled by the Center for Integrated Earth System Information (CIESIN) at Columbia University from the national Health Facility Registry, the primary health care agency's list, vaccination and malaria campaign surveys and GRID3 field collection. Each point has its name, state, local government area and ward, coordinates, and in the country-wide edition its category, ownership, level (primary, secondary or tertiary), functional status and data source. Version 2.0 covers all of Nigeria; version 3.0, released in August 2026, supersedes it for 24 states. The data are free and available to download from the Humanitarian Data Exchange as GeoPackage, CSV, GeoJSON, shapefile or KML under CC BY 4.0, with release notes describing the inputs and cleaning. Caveats: the producers describe the data as non-exhaustive and non-validated, positional accuracy depends on the input source, and the two versions have to be combined for national coverage. Simulation uses: mapping health facilities against flood and conflict exposure, modelling travel time to care from gridded population, and planning emergency and vaccination logistics. Related records: Healthsites.io (data-healthsites-io) is a global open facility map, and the HeiGIT accessibility indicators (data-heigit-accessibility-indicators) derive access to health facilities.
